name: CompuServe Pacific
summary: CompuServe's Australian service; operated as 'CompuServe Pacific' (managed in part by Fujitsu Australia); dial-in nodes from ~1991; phased out after AOL's 1998 global acquisition of CompuServe, shut down in the early 2000s.

events.details: CompuServe Pacific launched via dial-in access nodes in Australia.
Phased out and shut down (after AOL's 1998 acquisition of CompuServe).
